headline: Amaravati Capital Reconstruction
original_text: Resuming the construction and development of Amaravati as the sole, world-class capital city of Andhra Pradesh.
explainer: The government has abandoned the three-capital model and restarted large-scale infrastructure projects to build out Amaravati's administrative and residential zones.
status_reason: Massive construction is underway with 95% of state housing complete and new arterial roads inaugurated. Targeted for full operation by 2027.
